format: JSON Lines; one complete feature object per non-empty line

availability_tiers.B: 25-100 ms: local computation or in-memory/precomputed cache lookup
availability_tiers.C: 100-500 ms: heavier local aggregation or a reliable near-real-time side feed
availability_tiers.D: 0.5-5 s: asynchronous metadata/RPC/service result; never gate the immediate model
availability_tiers.E: Too slow, unstable, or hindsight-dependent for immediate entry

interpretation.availability_tier: Earliest realistic causal availability in a prospective local implementation, not a claim that the retrospective V1 builder currently achieves that latency.
interpretation.evidence_grade: Strength for predictive/risk usefulness, not confidence that the arithmetic definition is correct.
interpretation.v1_scanned: Whether the frozen scanner actually admitted the numeric field to its generic quantile scan; false for new candidates and mintAgeMs.
interpretation.priority: P0 instrument/implement first, P1 high-value follow-on, P2 exploratory, P3 low value, REJECT do not use as immediate alpha.
